about.title: About me
about.paragraph: With over a decade of experience in transforming bodies and lives, I blend strength training with rehabilitative care to help clients reach peak performance. Whether you're aiming to build muscle, recover from injury, or improve posture, I tailor every plan to your personal goals and needs. Consistency, discipline, and proper technique are at the core of every success story.

banner.description: Pick a training or program that best fits your goals and lifestyle.

bodybuilding.title: Bodybuilding
bodybuilding.description: Bodybuilding focuses on maximizing muscle hypertrophy through higher training volume, muscle isolation, and aesthetic physique development.

powerbuilding.title: Powerbuilding
powerbuilding.description: Powerbuilding combines the strength focus of powerlifting with the muscle-building goals of bodybuilding — the best of both worlds.

powerlifting.title: Powerlifting
powerlifting.description: Powerlifting is centered around building maximal strength in the squat, bench press, and deadlift through low-rep, high-intensity training.
